## `activity-audits list`

Retrieves list of Activity Audits with pagination (sorting and filtering)

```
epm-cli activity-audits list [flags]
```

API: `GET /v3/ActivityAudits` · Response: `ActivityAuditListItemModelPagedResponse`

**Filters and parameters**

| Flag | Type | Values | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--sort FIELD[:asc\|desc]` | repeatable | | sort order, e.g. `--sort created:desc` |
| `--page-size` | integer |  | The number of records per page, for example 1. Shouldn't exceed 200. |
| `--page` | integer |  | The page number to retrieve from results, for example 1 |
| `--user` | string |  | Initiated User email or API Client identifier |
| `--details` | string |  | Details of activity |
| `--created-dates` | list of date-time |  | Valid date formats for filter - 2020-12-24, 2020-12-24 19:09:47, 2020-12-24 19:09:47.6816562, 2020-12-24 19:09:47.6816562 +00:00 |
| `--created-selection-mode` | string | `Single`, `Multiple`, `Range` | The selection mode of date criteria e.g single, multiple, range |
| `--entity` | string |  | Name of Activity Audit entity |
| `--audit-type` | string |  | Audit Type Name |
| `--changed-by` | string | `API`, `Portal`, `ManagementRule`, `Pathfinder` | Audit ChangedBy |
| `--all`, `-A` | switch | | fetch every page |
| `--max-pages` | integer | | with `--all`: stop after N pages |

**Example**

```sh
epm-cli activity-audits list --all -o json
```
